patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Clay and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Snov.io's shape. Choose Snov.io only if your buying job matches “Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter fr” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage: Clay leans lead-management; Snov.io leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; Snov.io is Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter from $39/mo..
- Company-size focus: Clay (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Snov.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clay-leaning lead-management vs Snov.io-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Snov.io — No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led.

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; Snov.io: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led; Contact database depth is lighter than ZoomInfo/Apollo-class breadth claims.

Poor-fit cases: Clay is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model · Snov.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led · Avoid Clay if you actually need Snov.io's motion (Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
